Getting Started
description: Use the Gumloop API to create agents, start chat sessions, and trigger automations programmatically.

title: List agents
description: List agents the caller has access to. Filter by team, search by name, or narrow to agents that use a specific tool or trigger. Results can be sorted with `sort_order` and paginated by sending `page_size` and/or `cursor`.

title: Create agent
description: Create a new agent. The authenticated caller must have permission to create agents on the target team.

title: Retrieve agent
description: Retrieve a single agent by ID.

title: Update agent
description: Update an existing agent. Only fields included in the request body are changed; omitted fields are left untouched.

title: List agent versions
description: List the immutable versions of an agent, newest first. Each entry is a point-in-time snapshot of the agent's configuration.

title: Retrieve agent version
description: Retrieve one immutable agent version: its full configuration (`composition`) plus the structured `changes` relative to the version before it. Use it to export an agent's configuration or to audit what changed between versions.

title: Attach or detach agent skills
description: Attach and/or detach skills on an agent using deltas. This is **not** a replace-list: skills you don't mention are left untouched.

title: List agent MCP servers
description: List the MCP servers (connectors) attached to an agent. Sensitive fields such as `secret_id` and `mcp_server_url` are scrubbed from the response.

title: Attach or update an agent MCP server
description: Attach an MCP server (connector) to an agent, or update its configuration if it's already attached (upsert).

title: Detach an agent MCP server
description: Detach an MCP server (connector) from an agent. This is idempotent — detaching a server that isn't attached returns `detached: false` rather than an error.

title: List sessions
description: List sessions for an agent with cursor-based pagination, optional filtering, and search.

title: Create session
description: Create a new session for an agent. When `input` is provided, the message is enqueued and the agent begins processing — the response returns `202` with the session in `processing` or `queued` state. When `input` is omitted, an idle session stub is created and the response returns `201`.

title: Retrieve session
description: Retrieve a session by ID, including its messages, current state, agent metadata, and participants.

title: Send message
description: Append a user message to an existing session and resume the agent. The session must be in a terminal state (`idle`, `completed`, or `failed`); sending to a session that is `processing` or `queued` returns `409 interaction_not_in_terminal_state`. To hand the agent a message while it is still busy, us…

title: Upload session file
description: Upload a file into a session's input namespace so it can be attached to a message. The response returns the stored path — pass it as `file_name` in the `attachments` array when sending a message on the same session.

title: Resolve approvals
description: Answer pending asks on a session that is paused in the `approval_required` state — tool approvals, human input requests, and checkpoints.

title: Queue message
description: Add a message to a session's queue instead of interrupting the agent. Queued messages are sent automatically, in order, when the agent finishes its current turn. A session's queue holds at most 20 messages.

title: List queued messages
description: List the messages waiting in a session's queue, in the order they will be sent. Queued messages are drained automatically when the agent finishes its current turn.

title: Update queued message
description: Replace the content of a message that is still waiting in the session's queue.

title: Delete queued message
description: Remove a message from the session's queue before it is sent.

title: Send queued message now
description: Send a queued message immediately instead of waiting for the agent to finish its current turn. Any in-progress run is aborted, the queued message is appended to the transcript, and the agent starts processing it.

title: Cancel session
description: Cancel an in-progress session. If the session is currently `processing` or `queued`, any running stream is aborted and the session is transitioned to `failed`. If the session is already `completed` or `failed`, its current state is returned unchanged.

title: List skills
description: List skills the caller has access to. Filter by team, search by name, or narrow to a specific creator, related MCP server, or agent.

title: Create skill
description: Upload a skill package and create a new skill. The package must include a `SKILL.md` with `name` and `description` frontmatter; uploads may be a single `.md` file (stored as `SKILL.md`), or a `.zip` / `.skill` archive containing `SKILL.md` at its root. The initial version is created automatically. M…

title: Update skill
description: Replace a skill's files with a new upload. Reparses `SKILL.md` to update the skill's `name`, `description`, and `metadata`, and creates a new version. Maximum upload size is 10 MB.

title: Delete skill
description: Permanently delete a skill. This is a soft-delete — the skill will no longer appear in listings or be usable by agents.

title: Download skill
description: Generate a signed URL to download a skill's contents as a `.skill` archive (ZIP). When `version_id` is provided, returns that exact version; otherwise returns the current draft.

title: List artifacts
description: List artifacts (files) produced by an agent. Optionally scope to a specific session, search by filename, sort, and paginate. Deleted files are excluded from the results.

title: Download artifact
description: Returns a signed download URL for an artifact, plus its filename, media type, and size. Follow `download_url` to fetch the file bytes.

title: List MCP servers
description: Return the catalog of MCP servers visible to the caller — Gumloop-hosted (`gumcp_server`), user-deployed Gumstack (`gumstack_server`), and custom (`mcp_server`) — along with each server's connection state.

title: Retrieve an MCP server
description: Return a single MCP server. The response populates `allowed_tool_call_ids` with the tool call IDs the caller is permitted to invoke on this server.

title: List MCP server tools
description: Return the tools exposed by an MCP server. When the server is not in `connected` state, `tools` is empty and `gumloop_auth_url` is returned so the caller can prompt the user to authenticate.

title: Call MCP tools
description: Execute a batch of 1–5 MCP tool calls. Calls run concurrently and each result reports its own `status`. When Gumloop accepts the request, MCP execution failures such as target server authentication, policy blocks, invalid tools, upstream HTTP errors, and connection failures are returned in `results[…

title: List evaluations
description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of evaluation results for a specific agent, newest first. Only completed and failed evaluations are returned (transient states like queued/in_progress are excluded).

title: Retrieve evaluation
description: Retrieve a single evaluation result by ID. The evaluation must belong to the specified agent.

title: Get evaluation metrics
description: Returns aggregated grade and tag counts for an agent's evaluations over a time window. Useful for dashboards and reporting on agent quality trends.

title: Get evaluation config
description: Retrieve the current evaluation configuration for an agent, including criteria, tags, data points, and sentiment settings.

title: Update evaluation config
description: Partially update the evaluation configuration for an agent. Omitted fields keep their current value. Provided list fields (criteria, tags, data_points) replace that list entirely.

title: Search Company Brain
description: Run a hybrid (semantic + keyword) search across the knowledge sources indexed in your [Company Brain](/core-concepts/brain) and return the most relevant, ranked snippets with citations.

title: List teams
description: List teams the authenticated caller belongs to.

title: Create chat completion
description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, multiplexed across every model Gumloop supports (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter routes). title: Manage workspace users

title: Manage custom role users

title: List custom role credit limits
description: This endpoint lists every active custom role in an organization together with its monthly credit limit, so external systems can manage credit limits programmatically. A `monthly_credit_limit` of `null` means the role sets no limit of its own. The limit applies to each member of the role individually…

title: Get custom role credit limit
description: This endpoint returns the monthly credit limit of one custom role. A `monthly_credit_limit` of `null` means the role sets no limit of its own.

title: Set custom role credit limit
description: This endpoint sets or clears the monthly credit limit of a custom role. The limit applies to each member of the role individually and takes effect immediately: member allowances are recalculated while preserving credits already used in the current billing cycle. Send `"monthly_credit_limit": null` t…

title: Export data
description: This endpoint allows enterprise organization administrators to create and initiate a comprehensive data export for their organization or specific workspaces.

title: Get data export status
description: This endpoint retrieves the status of a data export job and optionally downloads the export file (as CSV) if the export has completed successfully.

title: Start flow run
description: This endpoint is used to trigger a flow run via API

title: Kill flow run
description: This endpoint is used to kill a flow run and all its subflow runs.

title: Retrieve run details
description: This endpoint can be used to poll for completion and retrieve final flow outputs. Output nodes must be used to retrieve outputs.
